project_name: LATECME - Sistema de Controle de Manufatura
vision: A comprehensive inventory and production control system for additive manufacturing facilities working with metallic materials

target_audience.primary: Manufacturing operations staff at additive manufacturing facilities working with metallic powder materials (operators, inventory managers, quality inspectors)
secondary: Production managers planning and monitoring manufacturing orders
Quality assurance personnel tracking material certifications
Plant administrators configuring system and managing users

phases.name: Foundation & Quality
phases.description: Establish production-ready quality through testing, documentation, and core UX improvements for daily use

milestones.title: Test Coverage Baseline
milestones.description: All core business logic (inventory, production, purchasing) has comprehensive test coverage

milestones.title: Mobile-Ready Interface
milestones.description: System is usable on tablets and mobile devices in warehouse/production floor environments

milestones.title: Document Management Ready
milestones.description: Users can upload and associate certificates and documents with materials and batches

phases.name: Operational Excellence
phases.description: Enhance daily operations with proactive alerts, better reporting, and streamlined workflows

milestones.title: Proactive Inventory Management
milestones.description: System automatically alerts users about low stock, expiring materials, and pending actions

milestones.title: Enhanced Dashboard & Analytics
milestones.description: Comprehensive dashboards with KPIs and production reports for management visibility

milestones.title: Workflow Acceleration
milestones.description: Bulk operations and keyboard shortcuts for power users to work faster

phases.name: Integration & Expansion
phases.description: Extend the system with external integrations, API access, and advanced traceability features

milestones.title: API Platform Ready
milestones.description: Full REST API with documentation enables third-party integrations

milestones.title: Barcode Integration
milestones.description: Mobile and hardware barcode scanners can be used for faster data entry

milestones.title: Complete Traceability
milestones.description: Full batch genealogy and traceability reports for compliance audits

phases.name: Scale & Market Expansion
phases.description: Prepare for broader market adoption with internationalization and enterprise features

milestones.title: Internationalization Ready
milestones.description: System supports multiple languages for international deployment

milestones.title: Enterprise Integration
milestones.description: ERP integration framework enables connection to SAP, Oracle, and other enterprise systems

milestones.title: Advanced Analytics
milestones.description: Predictive analytics and advanced composition analysis for process optimization

features.title: Comprehensive Test Suite for Core Business Logic
features.description: Expand automated test coverage to include all critical business logic in inventory management, production orders, purchasing workflows, and batch preparation. Include unit tests, integration tests, and API tests.
features.rationale: With only 4 test files currently, the system lacks confidence for safe refactoring and deployment. Manufacturing systems require high reliability - errors in inventory or batch tracking can have costly consequences.
acceptance_criteria: Test coverage reaches at least 70% for core apps (inventory, production, purchasing)
All critical business logic paths have corresponding tests
CI pipeline runs tests automatically on every PR
No regressions in existing functionality after test implementation
user_stories: As a developer, I want comprehensive tests so that I can refactor with confidence
As a plant administrator, I want a reliable system so that inventory data is always accurate

features.title: Mobile-Responsive Interface
features.description: Optimize the user interface for tablets and mobile devices, enabling use in warehouse and production floor environments. Focus on touch-friendly interactions, larger tap targets, and responsive layouts.
features.rationale: Manufacturing staff need to use the system while moving through the facility - receiving shipments at the dock, checking inventory in the warehouse, and preparing batches on the production floor. Desktop-only interfaces create friction.
acceptance_criteria: All list views are usable on tablets (10-inch screens)
Forms can be completed on mobile devices without horizontal scrolling
Navigation works well with touch interactions
Critical workflows (receiving, stock movement, batch prep) work on mobile
user_stories: As a warehouse operator, I want to use the system on my tablet so that I can record stock movements at the bin location
As a production operator, I want to view batch details on a mobile device so that I don't need to return to a workstation

features.title: Document & Certificate Upload System
features.description: Enable users to upload and associate PDF certificates, test reports, and other documents with materials, batches, and supplier records. Include document versioning and expiration tracking.
features.rationale: Material certificates, test reports, and compliance documents are essential for quality control and audits in additive manufacturing. Currently, there's no way to store these documents within the system, forcing users to maintain separate filing systems.
acceptance_criteria: Users can upload PDF, JPG, and PNG files to material records
Documents can be associated with specific batches
Supplier certificates can be stored with expiration dates
Documents are searchable and filterable by type and date
Document preview is available in-browser
user_stories: As a quality inspector, I want to upload material certificates so that they are easily accessible during audits
As a receiving clerk, I want to attach supplier test reports to incoming shipments so that quality can review them

features.title: Skeleton Loading States for Data Tables
features.description: Add skeleton loading states to all data tables to improve perceived performance and user experience during data loading. Replace blank spaces with animated placeholders.
features.rationale: Users in busy manufacturing environments need immediate feedback that the system is working. Blank loading states can be mistaken for errors or system hangs.
acceptance_criteria: All list views show skeleton loading animation while data loads
Skeleton matches the expected layout of the loaded content
Loading state is visible for at least 200ms to prevent flash
user_stories: As a user, I want to see loading indicators so that I know the system is fetching data

features.title: Keyboard Accessibility for Modal Dialogs
features.description: Ensure all modal dialogs are fully keyboard accessible with proper focus management, escape to close, and tab trapping.
features.rationale: Accessibility is important for users with disabilities and improves productivity for keyboard-oriented users. Modal dialogs are used extensively in the application.
acceptance_criteria: Focus is trapped within modal when open
Escape key closes modals
Focus returns to trigger element when modal closes
All interactive elements in modals are keyboard accessible
user_stories: As a keyboard user, I want to navigate modals without a mouse so that I can work efficiently

features.title: ARIA Labels for Icon-Only Action Buttons
features.description: Add proper ARIA labels to all icon-only buttons throughout the application to improve screen reader accessibility.
features.rationale: Icon-only buttons are common in the action columns of tables but provide no context for screen reader users. This is a quick win for accessibility compliance.
acceptance_criteria: All icon-only buttons have aria-label attributes
Labels clearly describe the action (e.g., 'Edit material', 'Delete supplier')
Screen readers announce button purposes correctly
user_stories: As a screen reader user, I want button labels to be announced so that I know what each button does

features.title: Low Stock Alerts & Notifications
features.description: Implement a notification system that alerts users when inventory falls below configurable thresholds. Include dashboard alerts and optional email notifications.
features.rationale: Preventing stockouts is critical for manufacturing continuity. Users currently must manually check inventory levels - proactive alerts reduce the risk of production delays.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set minimum stock thresholds per material
Dashboard shows alert badges for low-stock materials
Alert list view shows all materials below threshold
Optional email notifications when thresholds are breached
Alerts clear when stock is replenished
user_stories: As an inventory manager, I want to be alerted when materials are running low so that I can reorder before we run out
As a purchasing specialist, I want automatic notifications so that I can create purchase requests proactively

features.title: Email Notification System
features.description: Implement a configurable email notification system for key events: low stock alerts, purchase request approvals, order status changes, and expiring certifications.
features.rationale: Users need to be notified of important events even when not actively using the system. Email notifications enable timely action on approvals and alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Users can configure notification preferences
Email templates are professional and branded
Notifications are sent for: low stock, pending approvals, status changes, expiring certs
Unsubscribe link is included in all emails
Email delivery is logged for troubleshooting
user_stories: As a buyer, I want email notifications for pending purchase requests so that I can approve them promptly
As a quality manager, I want alerts for expiring certificates so that I can request renewals

features.title: Production Module Dashboard
features.description: Create a comprehensive dashboard for the production module showing KPIs: active orders, batch status, material utilization, and production timeline.
features.rationale: Production managers need a quick overview of manufacturing status. A dedicated dashboard reduces time spent digging through lists and improves decision-making.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows production order status distribution
Active batches and their current status are visible
Material consumption and bin utilization are displayed
Recent activity timeline shows latest actions
Quick links to common production tasks
user_stories: As a production manager, I want a dashboard so that I can see production status at a glance
As a shift supervisor, I want to see active batches so that I can prioritize work

features.title: Production Reports View
features.description: Add a reports section to the production module with configurable reports: production output, material usage, batch history, and quality metrics.
features.rationale: Reporting is minimal in the current system. Production managers need historical reports for planning, compliance, and continuous improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Users can generate reports for configurable date ranges
Reports include: production output, material consumption, batch history
Reports can be exported to PDF and CSV
Charts visualize trends over time
Reports respect user permissions
user_stories: As a production manager, I want monthly production reports so that I can track performance
As a quality manager, I want batch history reports for compliance audits

features.title: Bulk Status Change for Production Orders
features.description: Enable users to select multiple production orders and change their status in bulk, reducing repetitive clicks for common workflow transitions.
features.rationale: Power users managing many orders waste time changing status one by one. Bulk operations significantly improve efficiency for high-volume operations.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox selection allows multi-select in order list
Bulk action dropdown appears when items are selected
Status change respects workflow rules (can't skip statuses)
Confirmation dialog shows count and target status
Activity log records bulk changes
user_stories: As a production coordinator, I want to mark multiple orders as complete at once so that I save time at end of shift

features.title: Date Range Filter for List Views
features.description: Add date range filtering capability to material lists, supplier lists, and transaction history to help users find records by date.
features.rationale: Users frequently need to find records from specific time periods - for audits, reconciliation, or troubleshooting. Date filtering is a basic expectation.
acceptance_criteria: Date range picker component is available on key list views
Users can filter by: today, this week, this month, custom range
Date filters can be combined with other filters
Filter state persists during session
Clear filter option resets to all dates
user_stories: As an auditor, I want to filter transactions by date range so that I can review specific periods
As a buyer, I want to see purchases from last month so that I can reconcile invoices

features.title: REST API Documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger
features.description: Generate and publish comprehensive API documentation using OpenAPI (Swagger) specification. Include authentication details, request/response examples, and error codes.
features.rationale: API documentation is essential for integration with other systems and for third-party developers. Currently there's no visible API documentation.
acceptance_criteria: All API endpoints are documented in OpenAPI format
Swagger UI is accessible at /api/docs/
Authentication flow is documented
Request/response examples are provided
Error responses are documented
user_stories: As a developer, I want API documentation so that I can build integrations
As an admin, I want to understand available APIs so that I can evaluate integration options

features.title: Webhook System for External Integrations
features.description: Implement a webhook system that can notify external systems of key events: new orders, status changes, low stock alerts, and receiving completions.
features.rationale: Webhooks enable push-based integration with other systems without polling. This is the foundation for connecting with external tools and automation.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can configure webhook endpoints
Events can be selected per webhook
Payloads include relevant entity data
Webhook delivery is retried on failure
Delivery logs show success/failure history
user_stories: As an admin, I want webhooks so that I can connect LATECME to our other business systems
As a developer, I want event notifications so that I can build automation workflows

features.title: Barcode Scanning Integration
features.description: Integrate with mobile device cameras and hardware barcode scanners for rapid data entry in receiving, stock movements, and batch preparation workflows.
features.rationale: Manual data entry is slow and error-prone. Barcode scanning can dramatically speed up inventory operations and reduce mistakes, especially in high-volume environments.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile camera can scan barcodes on EPL labels
Hardware USB/Bluetooth scanners work with web interface
Scanning auto-populates material/bin/batch fields
Scan history is logged for troubleshooting
Works offline with sync when connection restored
user_stories: As a warehouse operator, I want to scan barcodes so that I can record stock movements quickly
As a receiving clerk, I want to scan incoming material labels so that I don't have to type codes manually

features.title: Batch Genealogy & Traceability Reports
features.description: Create comprehensive traceability reports showing the complete history of a batch: source materials, bins used, production order, and chemical composition at each stage.
features.rationale: Full traceability from raw material to finished batch is critical for quality control, compliance, and recall management in additive manufacturing.
acceptance_criteria: Batch detail view shows complete material genealogy
Source bins and their material origins are traced
Composition changes through mixing are documented
Traceability report can be exported as PDF
Forward traceability shows what batches used a material
user_stories: As a quality manager, I want to trace batch composition back to source materials for compliance audits
As a production engineer, I want to understand material lineage when investigating quality issues

features.title: Chemical Composition Analytics
features.description: Add analytics for chemical composition data: composition trends over time, variance analysis, and specification compliance checking.
features.rationale: Chemical composition is a key differentiator of the system. Analytics on composition data would provide additional value for quality control and process optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows composition distribution across inventory
Alerts when composition approaches specification limits
Historical composition trends for materials
Comparison view for batches from same material
Export composition data for external analysis
user_stories: As a metallurgist, I want to analyze composition trends so that I can identify quality patterns
As a quality manager, I want composition alerts so that I catch out-of-spec materials early

features.title: Multi-Language Support (i18n)
features.description: Internationalize the application to support multiple languages, starting with English translation. Enable language switching and maintain Brazilian Portuguese as the default.
features.rationale: The system is currently Portuguese-only, limiting market expansion. English support would open the system to international additive manufacturing facilities.
acceptance_criteria: All UI strings are externalized for translation
English translation is complete and accurate
Users can switch language in settings
Date and number formats adapt to locale
New translations can be added without code changes
user_stories: As an international user, I want to use the system in English so that I can understand all features
As a multinational company, I want language options for our facilities in different countries

features.title: ERP Integration Framework
features.description: Create an integration framework with adapters for common ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) to synchronize inventory, orders, and supplier data.
features.rationale: Large manufacturing facilities typically have ERP systems. Integration reduces double data entry and enables LATECME to serve as a specialized module within existing infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Integration framework supports bidirectional sync
At least one ERP adapter is implemented (e.g., SAP)
Conflict resolution strategy handles concurrent updates
Sync logs enable troubleshooting
Integration can be enabled/disabled per module
user_stories: As an IT manager, I want ERP integration so that I don't have to maintain duplicate data
As a finance user, I want purchase orders to sync to our ERP for accounting

features.title: Demand Forecasting Dashboard
features.description: Implement basic demand forecasting based on historical consumption patterns to help with inventory planning and purchasing decisions.
features.rationale: Predictive inventory management would be a significant competitive advantage, helping facilities optimize stock levels and reduce both stockouts and excess inventory.
acceptance_criteria: System analyzes historical consumption patterns
Forecast shows expected usage for next 30/60/90 days
Reorder recommendations based on lead times
Accuracy metrics show forecast performance
Manual overrides for known future changes
user_stories: As an inventory planner, I want consumption forecasts so that I can plan purchases proactively
As a purchasing manager, I want reorder recommendations so that I optimize inventory investment

features.title: Advanced Audit Logging
features.description: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all data changes with user attribution, timestamps, old/new values, and compliance reporting capabilities.
features.rationale: Manufacturing compliance often requires detailed audit trails. Current logging may not capture all the detail needed for regulatory audits.
acceptance_criteria: All create/update/delete operations are logged
Logs include user, timestamp, and old/new values
Audit logs are tamper-evident
Compliance reports can be generated for date ranges
Logs can be filtered by user, entity type, and action
user_stories: As a compliance officer, I want detailed audit trails for regulatory reviews
As an admin, I want to see who changed what and when for troubleshooting
